ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels, characterized by dense white mottling on a dark pigmented background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pigmentation forms solid contiguous bands at the distal tips of both lobes; the central and medial regions consist of high-frequency, roughly circular white motifs (rosettes) on a black field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated shallow V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 145 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous fine-scale serrations visible along the entire trailing edge boundary; the right lobe displays a more pronounced, irregular pixel-amplitude jaggedness compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a slight upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial distribution of circular high-contrast white pixel clusters across the central and lower-lateral regions of both lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct vertical, parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the left-medial lobe surface adjacent to the central notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant vertical rake marks on the left-medial lobe and comprehensive circular scarring patterns (rosettes) across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive and asymmetrical white terminal patches at the outer fluke tips.
